description: Match a sheet of page facts to a domain's pages before writing meta. A row matches by a full URL, by an ID inside the page URL such as /gamepage/7092, or by the name in slug form. Returns the matched pages with the facts each will get, new pages built from the learned address pattern that will be added to the inventory, and rows with no page. Changes nothing. Needs a token.

domain.description: The connected domain, as a hostname, e.g. example.com.

file.description: Path to an .xlsx, .csv or .tsv file on this machine, instead of rows.

rows.description: The sheet as rows of cells. Each row needs the page URL, or an ID or name that appears in the URL.

section.description: Only match pages under this path, e.g. /br/casino. Defaults to /.

name: match_page_facts
title: Match page facts
